node.statement: An element X of M_r(C^n) is a tuple (X_1,...,X_n) with norm max_j ||X_j||. After the canonical tensor-factor permutation, J_r(X) is block diagonal diag(X_1,...,X_n), so ||J_r X|| = max_j ||X_j||. For A in M_r(M_n), D_r(A) is the tuple of diagonal n-by-n blocks (A_{11},...,A_{nn}); each A_{jj} is a compression of A and has norm at most ||A||. Thus J_r is isometric, D_r is contractive, and direct extraction after inclusion gives D_r J_r=I.
